args.text:
Batch: 15 runs. 15 accepted, 15 flagged, 0 cleared.
Flagged, all for check_failed_but_accepted:
- r02, r06, r10, r12, r13, r15: failed all three checks (rigid invariance 39.9–124.8 vs 2; closure 1.4–29.6 vs 1; plane sections 31.7–172.6 vs 3.25). r12's strain-rate profile also has a different shape: peak at 53 µm vs 316, growth zone 105 µm vs 526.
- r01, r05, r11: failed rigid invariance (42.6–99.2) and plane sections (5.7–34.5). Their profiles also differ from the batch: REGR peak 74–122 %/h vs 42.5, growth zone 263–410 µm vs 526.
- r03, r04, r14: failed only plane sections (9.0–11.3 vs 3.25). Profiles match the batch.
- r07, r08, r09: failed only closure (2.92–2.93 vs 1), so the tip velocity from the midline and stage log does not match the tracked kinematics. Profiles match the batch.
What the flagged runs have in common: each was accepted with at least one failed final check. None used the width-free ratio, so plane sections ran in every case. Each used one step with no remedies kept and no roll-backs, so none of the failures was addressed before acceptance. The acceptance step appears to ignore failed kinematic checks and should be reviewed.
